headline: Fed’s Watchdog Finds No Misconduct or Illegal Activity in Costly Renovations
context: A new report by the Federal Reserve’s independent inspector general concluded that a nearly $2.5 billion construction project was poorly managed but made no referrals to the U.S. attorney general.
